biography.plain_text: Jordan Zimmerman is an American advertising entrepreneur who founded Zimmerman Advertising in Fort Lauderdale. A University of South Florida graduate, he started the agency with his savings after failing to find a job in New York. He later sold the business to Omnicom and bought it back after more than two decades.

long_biography.plain_text:
Jordan Zimmerman's advertising pitches began with research into a client's business. Before seeking the Great Expectations dating-service account, his team studied its sales and competitors, then tested five proposed campaigns with focus groups. The agency won the account. Its own production studio also allowed staff to change advertisements quickly without commissioning outside production.

Zimmerman brought students into that working environment through the advertising programme he founded at the University of South Florida. Interns spent twelve weeks at his agency on live client assignments. In one summer, two students joined a team developing a McDelivery campaign and travelled to Chicago to present their proposal at McDonald's headquarters.
